sp.name: Jidka wareejinta
sp.numbers: Wax kasta halkan waa caawiye qorsheyn. Injineerku go'aanka ayuu gaadhaa: natiijadu ma aha shahaado, naqshad la saxeexay, ama bayaan ah in gaari uu wadada isticmaali karo ama uu ka hor yimid. Ma muujinayo dhaqdhaqaaq, dhakhaatir, xawaare ama habdhaqanka darawalka; waxaa keliya lagu muujiyaa joometriga xawaaraha hoose.
sp.privacy: Mashruucaaga wuxuu ku sii jiraa kombiyuutarkan. Waxba halkan looma diro.
sp.placeholder: Tirooyin meel-hayn ah oo aan la xaqiijin. Gaarida ka dhig gaariga naqshadeynta ee degmadaadu u baahan tahay (nuqul ka samee hoose, ka beddel) ka hor intaadan natiijada isticmaalin.
sp.veh.help: Gaari waa tilmaam yar oo JSON ah oo ku qoran mitir iyo darajo. Tirooyinka beddel, kadibna kaydi: nuqulku waa kaaga, magaciisuna waa my-…, wuuna had iyo jeer ahaan doonaa aan la xaqiijin ilaa aad hubiso.
sp.err.json: Taasi ma aha JSON sax ah.
sp.err.nopath: Marka hore dooro jid-isku-xidh ama xarriiq leh ugu yaraan laba barta.
sp.err.norun: Marka hore gaari ku socod jid.
sp.err.noboundary: Marka hore xarriiq xidhan ku sawir goobta, kadibna riix Cusboonaysii.
sp.err.roadonly: Hubintan waxay u baahan tahay gaari waddo.
sp.run.help: Gaari waddo ama hoosta diyaaradda ayaa jidka ku raacda dhabarka hore; dib u socodku waxa uu raacaa dhabarka ugu dambeeya. Gaari tareen fudud ayaa labada dhabar waddada ku haya.
sp.r.steer: Xagalka ugu weyn ee wareegga / xadka
sp.r.art: Xagalka ugu weyn ee isku-xidhka / xadka
sp.stamped: {n} xarriiq ayaa naqshadda lagu sawiray (hal tallaabo ka noqo).
sp.obs.none: Naqshadda ma jiro xarriiq ama parcel ah oo lagu hubin karo.
sp.clr.help: Calaamadee wax kasta oo gaarigu taabanayn waayo, hagaar masaafada, kana hubi socodkii u dambeeyay. Khalad kasta wuxuu noqonayaa Dhibaato aad u tagi karto.
sp.clr.hit: {n} caqabadood ayaa la taabtay ama way ka dhow yihiin hagaarka.
sp.issue.conflict: {v} waxay u dhowaatay {d} {u} dhinaca {name} marka uu jidka dhexdiisa ku yahay {s} {u}.
sp.issue.steer: {v} wuxuu u baahan yahay xagal wareeg oo {value} darajo; xadkiisa waa {limit}.
sp.issue.articulation: {v} wuxuu isku xidhaa {value} darajo; xadkiisa waa {limit}.
sp.issue.short: Jidku gaaban yahay in {v} lagu socodsiiyo.
sp.issue.hitch: Xidhka gaari-raaca ee {v} wuxuu kor ka yaal dhabarka; waxaa loo qaadanayaa inuu dhabarka saaran yahay.
sp.rb.help: Wareeg ka sawir goobo, xariiq wadid iyo jidadkiisa, kadibna gaari waddo oo dhammaan galalka iyo bixitaanka ku socod. Dhaqdhaqaaqyadu waa jidad la nadiifiyay; geesta dhexe ayaa keliya laga hubiyaa caqabad.
sp.rb.apron: Ballaca dhulka baabuurta waaweyn ({u}, 0 haddii aan jirin)
sp.rb.legs: Xagasha jidadka darajooyinka (0 = bari, sida saacadda soo-horjeedda)
sp.rb.note: Xagasha ka baxsan xadka iyo gaadhista geesta dhexe waa la calaamadiyay. Wareegu wuxuu kaloo u baahan yahay hubin fogaanta aragga iyo jaangooynta soo-galka; kan ma sameynayo.
sp.pk.help: Meelaha iyo waddo gudaha xariiq xidhan ku habayn, tiro, kadibna hubi sida gaarida la doortay ugu galayso meelaha ugu adag iyadoo deriskiisu buuxo.
sp.pk.nobays: Ma jiro meel ku habboon: goobta ka dhig mid weyn ama meelaha yar.
sp.pk.fine: Gaarida waxay gelaysaa meesha ugu adag iyadoon taabanayn deriskeeda, iyadoonna ka bixin xadka wareegga.
sp.pk.trouble: {n} meelood oo deris ah ayaa la taabtay, {p} xadka wareegga ama isku-xidhka ayaana la gaadhay.
sp.pk.note: Meesha ugu adag waa midda ugu dambeysa safka ugu dambeeya. Jidku waa wareeg nadiifiyay oo ka soo baxa waddada; darawal dhab ah wuu ka wanaagsan karaa ama ka xun.
